title: ADVANCING TRANSFORMATIVE EDUCATION: GENERATIVE AI AS A CATALYST FOR EQUITY AND INNOVATION

bias_targets.methodology: Observational case study analysis and literature review evaluating the impact of infrastructure limitations, device access disparities, and the digital divide on students from low-income and rural backgrounds.
Qualitative literature review identifying AI systems' tendency to heavily favor English-language content, thereby disadvantaging non-native speakers.
Qualitative literature review discussing how AI training data perpetuates cultural stereotypes and lacks cultural adaptability for diverse global learners.
Qualitative literature review highlighting the risk of AI models perpetuating existing gender stereotypes inherited from training datasets into personalized educational content.
